Enum Class Season

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<Season>
org.swarmforge.core.world.Season
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<Season>, Constable
public enum Season extends Enum<Season>
Represents the four seasons with their effects on the simulation. Each season affects temperature, food availability, and ant behavior.
